quote: the nuclear production sites known to it without using nuclear weapons (i.e., at present, the plutonium production reactor at Pao-T'ou and the incomplete gaseous diffusion plant at Lan-Chou)
notes: Named as a known nuclear production site that a US non-nuclear air attack could put out of action. Study concluded direct action not justified absent major ChiCom aggression (selected left blank: no decision). Text notes 'two other areas' that may contain plutonium facilities (unnamed).
